description: Large vertical stroke starting a third of the way from the bottom and ending a third of the way from the top. Beneath the vertical stroke, and horizontal, an unleveled stroke, centered, is a third of the width. Three small dots are positioned above the vertical stroke. Four circles , the shape of a reverse "L," are to the left of the vertical stroke. Two circles are on the right of the vertical stroke.
